statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-118741 is in the ASP.NET Core Identity templates that dotnet new and the ASP.NET Core scaffolding tools generate: the generated password-reset and email-confirmation handlers send to the email address supplied in the request instead of the account's stored address (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/525, https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-118741). Microsoft lists Microsoft.DotNet.Web.ProjectTemplates.10.0 up to 10.0.14 as affected and 10.0.15 as fixed. This owner ships that template package: its dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap package carries a .NET 10 SDK whose templates directory holds it, and its dotnet10-runtime-artifacts package carries the same template package as a NuGet package. Listed the x86_64 bootstrap and artifacts packages of 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0 for Alpine 3.24; 10.0.14-r0 holds microsoft.dotnet.web.projecttemplates.10.0 version 10.0.14 and 10.0.15-r0 holds version 10.0.15. Every earlier build of this owner is an older .NET 10 servicing release. As Microsoft notes, updating the templates does not repair application code already generated from an affected template.
